recognize_zh: 中倍下骨小樑兩側被深藍色的小淋巴球浸潤帶緊貼包圍（尤其骨小樑右側與左上），而遠離骨頭的區域則是含紅色顆粒球前驅細胞與巨核細胞的正常造血；這種沿骨小樑分布的淋巴浸潤是濾泡性淋巴瘤侵犯骨髓的招牌模式。
features: Hypercellular marrow with bony trabeculae and scant fat
Dense bands of small, dark lymphoid cells hugging and following the trabecular surfaces (paratrabecular infiltrate)
Clear contrast between the monotonous blue lymphoid band and the adjacent intertrabecular hematopoietic marrow
Residual hematopoiesis with eosinophilic granulocytic precursors and scattered megakaryocytes away from bone
Cytologic detail limited at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, low-medium power) shows a hypercellular marrow in which sheets of small, dark-staining lymphoid cells are applied directly to the surfaces of the bony trabeculae, forming broad paratrabecular bands. The intertrabecular spaces away from bone contain residual trilineage hematopoiesis, including granulocytic precursors and megakaryocytes. The lymphoid infiltrate is cytologically monotonous, although nuclear detail is limited at this power. The paratrabecular pattern is characteristic of bone marrow involvement by follicular lymphoma, to be confirmed with immunohistochemistry.

ddx.vs: Reactive aggregates are small, round, sharply circumscribed and intertrabecular, rather than broad bands spread along the trabecular surface.
MCL can show paratrabecular involvement but is CD5-positive and cyclin D1-positive with t(11;14).
The normal paratrabecular zone is a thin rim of maturing myeloid cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm, not a thick band of dark, monotonous lymphocytes.
